{{Quote|Of course. I haven't heard of Grand Admiral Thrawn, either. Certainly not in connection with the ''Chimaera''. Or with some intriguing information raids on several systems in the Paonnid/Obroa-skai region, either.|Talon Karrde|<ref name="HttE" />}}
The '''Paonid system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The [[Paonnid]]s were native to this system.<ref name="HttE">''[[Heir to the Empire]]''</ref> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the system was neutral following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] and was eager to join the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] during the [[Thrawn campaign]].<ref name="HttES">''[[Heir to the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Paonid system was first mentioned in the novel ''[[Heir to the Empire]]'' which used instinctively the spellings Paonnid and Paonidd.<ref name="HttE" /> Likely for simplification, later sources used the spelling Paonid.<ref name="HttES" /><ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II||Obroa-skai}}</ref><ref name="EAOC" />
